PRICE LISTED IS PER BED For clarity and transparency, we’ve outlined the fees you may encounter as a resident below. Some charges are required as part of your lease agreement, while others are optional or situational, based on your preferences and usage. If you have any questions about how these fees apply to you, our team is always happy to help. View Fees One-Bedroom Apartments Our one-bedroom apartments feature 1 and 1.5 bathroom layouts , offering flexible living options designed for comfort and convenience. These homes provide a well-balanced space with open living areas and a private bedroom, ideal for those seeking a more independent and streamlined lifestyle. Two-Bedroom Apartments Our two-bedroom apartments offer a wide range of layouts with 1, 1.5, 2, and 2.5 bathroom configurations , allowing you to choose a setup that fits your lifestyle. Designed for shared living, these homes provide functional interiors with a natural flow between living spaces, creating a comfortable environment for both privacy and connection. Three-Bedroom Apartments Our three-bedroom apartments feature 1.5, 2, 2.5, and 3 bathroom layouts , delivering versatile living options for larger households. With thoughtfully arranged interiors, these homes offer the flexibility needed for both shared and individual living while maintaining a comfortable and efficient layout. Four-Bedroom Apartments Our four-bedroom apartments include 2, 2.5, 3, and 4 bathroom configurations , providing spacious layouts designed for shared living at a larger scale. With multiple bathroom options and well-defined living areas, these homes support both privacy and functionality for everyday living. Check out our other locations in Blacksburg!
